notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.content:
Major update on The Night of the Inquisitor!
[list]
[*] Bug fixed: If you finish the game and start a new playthrough... the candle was gone
[*] Bug: When you die it is possible for you to interact with the candle and bug the whole game UI

[*] Bug fixed: Bug: accidentally dropping the candle by the big stone head would make it imposible to pick up again.
[*] Bug fixed: It was imposible to get the bad ending.

[*] Feature: When you die, if the candle is in some place, make it spawn next to the player.
[*] Feature: Make the VHS filter optional
[*] Feature: Added different Filters
[*] Feature: Added several overlays, including a Christmas overlay
[*] Feature: Third secret Goofy ending
[*] Feature: Achievements
[/list]

notes.title: Extra Easter Eggs and Extra Music.
notes.content:
[h2]Update 1.0.1[/h2]
First of all thank you all that purchased the game already. 
Here's some minor changes I added to the game:
- Added extra changes to the soundtrack of the game to make it a little bit more tense.
- Added a Poster as an Easter egg in the Arcade section that will be part of a deeper Easter egg in a future update. Most players won't read this, so if you're reading it, now you know ;)

Again thanks for purchasing TNOTI and expect more updates to come. I just need some feedback from players in order to know what to add or what to fix. Remember you can always send me feedback directly.
